x-changelog.4.27.0: 2026-07-07 -- Harness audit wave 1: full 5-agent audit of every skill, hook, and agent. Deletes 12 skills that were dead, contradictory, or duplicated (obsidian-vault, scaffold-exercises, setup-pre-commit, git-guardrails-claude-code, teach, migrate-to-shoehorn, implement, loop-me, research, weekly-review, efficient-fable, quick-recap) after porting unique content into survivors (what-did-i-get-done, read-the-damn-docs, go, efficient-frontier). Strips the duplicated /deslop preamble from all 94 SKILL.md files. Converts work + the writing family to zero-context slash-only skills (disable-model-invocation). Unwires three Stop-hook category errors (architecture-review-stop, perf-regression-stop, cache-telemetry-stop). Fixes test-warning-check's substring command gate that misfired on file reads. Replaces the python3-at-source-time timer in the hook lib with EPOCHREALTIME (removes ~56 interpreter spawns per edit). Trims intent-detect and orchestration-guidance to dynamic-context-only, ending per-prompt CLAUDE.md restatement (~2-4k tokens/session). Skills 95 -> 83; wired hooks 98 -> 95; hook scripts 108 -> 104. Full audit report: docs/harness-audit-2026-07-07.md. Wave 2 (same release): review-stack collapse (thermo-nuclear folds into /review --deep; mandatory 8-hat fan-out replaced by evidence-triggered lanes), ponytail family 4 -> 1 (debt ledger into ponytail, complexity tags into deslop), stay-within-limits -> efficient-frontier, claude-handoff -> handoff, frontend-skills-stats -> hook-audit, commit-push becomes a zero-context alias of commit-push-pr; 11 low-value per-edit pattern hooks deleted (tdd-prompt, url-state, unhappy-path, resilience-review-nudge, magic-number, duplicate-function, zustand-subscription, mutation-naming, structural-test-nudge, route-sibling-test, route-visual-test); agents cleanup (karpathy-failure-modes split into 6KB core + lazy MAST reference, findings-schema moved to agents/references/, shared review-evidence reference extracted, hardcoded HEAD~1 diff base replaced with merge-base default). Skills 83 -> 76; wired hooks 95 -> 84; hook scripts 104 -> 93; registered agents 9 -> 7.

x-changelog.4.9.0: 2026-04-23 -- Green != done warnings gate (+2 hooks, 89->91 wired / 98->100 scripts). `test-warning-check.sh` (PostToolUse Bash) scans passing `vitest`/`bun test`/`playwright`/`tsgo`/`biome`/`lint` output for curated warning patterns: Node `DeprecationWarning` + `ExperimentalWarning` + `(node:...) XxxWarning`, React `act()`/missing-key/DOM-nesting/prop-type/bad-setstate/non-boolean-attr, unhandled promise rejection / unhandled error, vitest `stderr |` during test, skipped-test counts, `@ts-expect-error` / `@ts-ignore`, `npm WARN deprecated`. No per-file or env warning bypass. 3x same-kind streak adds a stop-rerunning reminder. `ci-warning-audit.sh` (Stop) fetches `gh run view <id> --log` on green PR CI (per-SHA cache, 45s timeout), greps same pattern, blocks with file:line sample + fetch-full command. Gates: feature branch, session touched code, PR exists, all checks SUCCESS (pending/fail defer to lifecycle-stop). No CI warning env bypass. CLAUDE.md Tests section adds green-not-done rule. tdd/SKILL.md `When Done` adds zero-warnings local + CI log audit checkboxes. Why: tests can be green while runtime spews deprecations / logs errors / leaks unhandled rejections -- noise rots into real bugs when the libs actually remove the API. Agent must clean before calling it done.
x-changelog.4.8.0: 2026-04-22 -- /steelman anti-sycophancy skill (opt-in only). New skill at steelman/SKILL.md argues strongest opposite case with repo evidence on user assertions -- factual/causal/architectural claim types only (preference/goal/scope declined). Procedure: identify claim -> fan-out evidence gather (grep, read, run) -> write counter-argument with file:line refs -> verdict (confirmed | contradicted | mixed). User-invoked via `/steelman` slash only. **No ambient CLAUDE.md rule, no automatic hook fire, no telemetry log script** -- plugin consumers see zero behavior change unless they type `/steelman`. Ambient premise-check directive + jsonl telemetry were considered and held back pending real-world feedback on the opt-in surface; re-evaluate once /steelman fire-rate data exists from dogfooding. Why: LLM sycophancy risk when the user asserts something wrong and the model agrees by default -- /steelman forces the strongest counter-case with repo evidence before proceeding. Skills 47 -> 48 (registers the skill file that was previously on disk but unlisted).
